mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(elapsed_ms), 0) FROM query_audit_log WHERE action_type = 'RANGE_QUERY' AND status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT id, action_type AS actionType, sql_text AS sqlText, table_name AS tableName, column_name AS columnName, lower_index AS lowerIndex, upper_index AS upperIndex, hit_count AS hitCount, elapsed_ms AS elapsedMs, status, detail_text AS detailText, created_at AS createdAt FROM query_audit_log WHERE action_type = 'RANGE_QUERY' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, policy_name AS policyName, sensitivity, segment_json AS segmentJson, active_flag AS activeFlag, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ope_policy_config WHERE active_flag = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, action_type AS actionType, sql_text AS sqlText, table_name AS tableName, column_name AS columnName, lower_index AS lowerIndex, upper_index AS upperIndex, hit_count AS hitCount, elapsed_ms AS elapsedMs, status, detail_text AS detailText, created_at AS createdAt FROM query_audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ope_policy_config (policy_name, sensitivity, segment_json, active_flag) VALUES (#{policyName}, #{sensitivity}, #{segmentJson}, #{activeFlag})
